description: Masks likely secrets and personal data in agent logs or chat text: 0x private keys (64 hex), labelled base58 private keys, JWTs, AWS access key ids, common API token prefixes (sk-, ghp_, xoxb-), payment card numbers that pass the Luhn check, and email addresses. Returns the redacted text and counts. Pattern-based: it can miss unusual formats and does not detect seed phrases or names. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
